scope: All 35 prime reference types through eight crossings, one independently eight-move-scrambled bank embedding per type and three fresh independent eight-move input scrambles per type. Fixed seeded bank and query permutations. No discarded/replaced case. Histories and evaluator labels stay outside the classifier; only vertex arrays enter it. Move locations unrestricted. Sixteen moves is a declared finite horizon, not minimum scramble distance or a crossing cap.
scheduler: Resumable fair full-bank iterative DFS; same driver in both lanes.
costScope: Lane elapsed includes all queries, full root domains, wrong references, failed contours, online learning, validation, certificate replay, cold initialization, and proof archival/checkpoints. Common preparation and independent audit separately reported. Prior-stage costs retained in combined reporting.
developmentPilot: First three fixed inputs tested during development; not scored or timed in this fresh full experiment.
selection: Every marked unknown from the original 105-case experiment, in unchanged query order. Both lanes retry exactly these selected cases against the unchanged 35-reference bank. No new scramble or saved marking import. All earlier costs retained in combined reporting.

learning.scope: Exact local vertex-capacity compatibility. All binary exterior profiles exhaustively probed; translations, signed coordinate permutations and traversal reversal preserve the point model. No target-dependent failure transfer.

extensions.scope: Translation only; full incident-face alphabet; target discrepancy window, finite remaining budget. Negative relaxed cover proofs are redundant constraints. No projection, knot label, invariant, or scramble provenance enters probes. Not the reference neighboring-pair/corona learner.

Finite failure remains knot unknown.
